OUR STORY
Tanzania is a magical land. A land of extraordinary sights and adventure — home to sweeping savannahs, dramatic escarpments, and abundant wildlife. It is a place where dreams take shape, and memories last a lifetime. Our property collection brings this magic to life, offering a seamless safari experience infused with warmth, care, and meticulous attention to detail.
Our portfolio features two exceptional properties in Northern Tanzania: Nyota Serengeti, a luxury tented camp in the heart of the Central Serengeti, and Nyota Rift Valley, a beautiful lodge perched above Lake Manyara with wonderful views.
READ MORE
About Nyota Camps & Lodges
Nyota Camps & Lodges offer two distinct yet complementary places to stay, each shaped by its landscape and designed for relaxed, thoughtful safari living. In the heart of the Serengeti, Nyota Serengeti Tented Camp places you close to wildlife and wide, open plains, where canvas, comfort, and the sounds of nature come together. Further south, Nyota Rift Valley Lodge sits high on the Rift Valley Escarpment, overlooking Lake Manyara below — a peaceful retreat with sweeping views and cooler air.

How can you explain the fascination of this vast, dusty continent, whose oldest roads are elephant paths? Could it be because Africa is the place of all our beginnings, the cradle of mankind, where our species first stood upright on the savannahs of long ago?”
— Brian Jackman

OUR STORY
Tanzania is a magical land. A land of extraordinary sights and adventure — home to sweeping savannahs, dramatic escarpments, and abundant wildlife. It is a place where dreams take shape, and memories last a lifetime. Our property collection brings this magic to life, offering a seamless safari experience infused with warmth, care, and meticulous attention to detail.
Our portfolio features two exceptional properties in Northern Tanzania: Nyota Serengeti, a luxury tented camp in the heart of the Central Serengeti, and Nyota Rift Valley, a beautiful lodge perched above Lake Manyara with wonderful views.
Nyota (rhyme it with ‘hotter’) means ‘stars’ in Swahili. Whilst on safari, we spend a lot of time searching the bush, the horizon, the trees and the geological landforms but we often forget to look above, where an ethereal world silently sparkles.
Why Stay with us
At Nyota, we believe your accommodation should be as memorable as the safari itself. Our camps and lodges are designed as places to slow down, connect with nature and experience genuine hospitality, thoughtfully created and deeply rooted in their surroundings.
Both Nyota Serengeti Tented Camp and Nyota Rift Valley Lodge are set in exceptional landscapes, chosen for their natural beauty, sense of space and proximity to wildlife. From the night sounds of the Serengeti to sweeping views across the Rift Valley, each location invites you to immerse yourself in Tanzania.
Our people are at the heart of the Nyota experience. We invest in our team, supporting their growth and skills so that guests feel truly welcomed and cared for.
Nyota Serengeti lies in the Central Serengeti, offering year-round wildlife and flexible safari itineraries. Nyota Rift Valley Lodge sits on the escarpment, providing a relaxed base to explore Tarangire, Lake Manyara, Ngorongoro Crater and Mto wa Mbu at an unhurried pace.
